name: 3S Industry Group Inc.
summary: 3S Industry Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides wind energy, construction, and safety protection equipment in China and internationally. The company offers service lifts, climb auto systems, climb assists, offshore davit cranes, aluminum ladders, suspended platforms, and passive smart locks and control systems. It also provides ladder hoists, trailer lifts, tower climbers, industrial elevators, transport platforms, construction hoists, retractable discharge platforms, mast climbing work platforms, and electric rope hoists.
